quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 deck, NAVER AI Factory Phase 1 200MW business structure (plan): as a result of NVIDIA's investment into NAVER ($1B), NAVER is to consolidate the AI Factory Operating Co. with a 100% stake; an SPV holds GPU and data-center ownership, purchases the GPUs from NVIDIA and handles site acquisition or lease, and Brookfield (preferred negotiation partner) is to invest up to $9B into the SPV and hold a majority stake (NAVER a minority stake if needed). The Operating Co. pays the SPV a computing expense per MW and sells a full-stack computing service to off-takers (customers) for computing revenue per MW.
quarterly_data.figure: Phase 1 200MW; NVIDIA $1B investment; Brookfield up to $9B into the GPU / data-center SPV (plan)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 deck, costs: the depreciation period for computing assets such as GPU and CPU was extended from 5 to 6 years to reflect actual useful life, an approximately 100bn KRW annual cost deferral effect; infrastructure expense rose 11.2% YoY to KRW 219.8 billion due to the change in depreciation period despite increased acquisition of computing assets. Operating profit was flat YoY as the acquisition of computing assets, contents and data raised costs (excluding Wallapop, the depreciation change and other one-off factors, operating profit grew 0.9% YoY).
quarterly_data.figure: GPU/CPU depreciation 5 to 6 years (~100bn KRW annual cost deferral); infrastructure expense KRW 219.8 billion (+11.2% YoY)
